tools.name: semble_get_practice
tools.description: The practice the API token belongs to: name, timezone, locations, appointment types and medical specialties. A good first call to check the connection.

tools.name: semble_list_patients
tools.description: Patients of the practice (personal and health data). `search` matches name, email, phone or date of birth. Returns id, name, date of birth, contact details and status, plus pageInfo.hasMore for the next page.

tools.name: semble_get_patient
tools.description: One patient by id (personal data): demographics, phones, address, numbers, custom attributes, labels, comments and status. Appointments, invoices and tasks have their own tools.

tools.name: semble_list_patient_bookings
tools.description: The bookings (appointments) of one patient between two dates, with doctor, location, appointment type and status. Both dates are required (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: semble_list_bookings
tools.description: Bookings (appointments) of the whole practice. With a date range, a booking is included if it starts or ends inside it. Returns patient, doctor, location, appointment type, status and journey (arrived, consultation, departed, dna).

tools.name: semble_get_booking
tools.description: One booking by id, with patient, doctor, location, appointment type, status and journey.

tools.name: semble_list_users
tools.description: Staff users of the practice (clinicians and admin): name, email, role, qualifications and specialties. Use the ids for bookings and tasks.

tools.name: semble_list_products
tools.description: The practice's price list: appointment types, services and stock items, with price, cost, duration and stock level. `search` matches the item code or name.

tools.name: semble_get_product
tools.description: One product, service or appointment type by id.

tools.name: semble_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices whose invoice date is inside a date range, with patient, totals and what is outstanding. Filter by status (active or cancelled) and paid_or_outstanding. Monetary amounts are in the practice currency.

tools.name: semble_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id, with its line items, totals and what is outstanding.

tools.name: semble_list_contacts
tools.description: Contacts of the practice (referring doctors, insurers and other payors). `search` matches name, email, phone, specialty and numbers.

tools.name: semble_list_tasks
tools.description: Practice tasks, filtered by patient, status, priority, type or assignee. Returns subject, due date, priority, assignee and patient.

tools.name: semble_list_labels
tools.description: The labels that can be put on patients (id, title, colour). Use the id with semble_add_patient_label.

tools.name: semble_create_task
tools.description: Creates a task in Semble assigned to a staff user (get ids from semble_list_users), optionally about a patient, with a due date, priority and type. Creates a new record each time it is called.

tools.name: semble_update_task
tools.description: Changes a task: close or reopen it (status), reassign it, move the due date, or edit subject, priority and notes. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: semble_add_patient_label
tools.description: Puts an existing label on a patient (label ids from semble_list_labels). Adds only; nothing is removed.

tools.name: semble_create_patient
tools.description: Creates a new patient record (personal data) from the details you give. It does not check for an existing patient: search with semble_list_patients first to avoid a duplicate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: semble_list_patients, semble_get_patient, semble_list_users, semble_list_contacts · Private data: semble_get_practice, semble_list_patients, semble_list_contacts, semble_create_task, semble_create_patient · Public sink: semble_list_patients, semble_list_users, semble_list_contacts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: semble_list_patients, semble_get_patient, semble_list_users, semble_list_contacts · Private data: semble_get_practice, semble_list_patients, semble_list_contacts, semble_create_task, semble_create_patient · Public sink: semble_list_patients, semble_list_users, semble_list_contacts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
